decision_summary: Promote the exact-M32, hidden-5120 residual-add plus centered-RMSNorm kernel and its layer-boundary Prefill schedule.
The selected kernel is bitwise-equivalent to the two-kernel baseline, including the rounded BF16 residual boundary, and reduces each selected CUDA Graph chain from two nodes to one.

Hot same-binary microbenchmarks reach about 1.497x, but production attribution reaches only 1.07029482x for the replaced GPU-kernel chain; the whole P513 prefix improves by 0.278109% in two independent B-C-C-B groups.
The optimization is deliberately limited to exact M32. Decode, M1, M2..M31, and Prefill tail tiles retain the prior schedule.

source.base_subject: docs: clarify Prefill residual fusion savings
source.candidate_tree: uncommitted production kernel, launcher, exact-M32 runner schedule, and tests on base_head

rebuilt_baseline_binary.source_note: The runtime source is identical to b09614c because b09614c..8b2ec34 changes documentation only.

historical_baseline_install_copy.relationship: The install copy preserved the original ELF Build ID and differed from the original target only because installation removed RUNPATH.
historical_baseline_install_copy.retention_note: The final package-consumer CTest subsequently overwrote this path with the candidate install; the exact baseline B-C-C-B logs remain retained and hashed.

fixed_frequency.claim_boundary: Named-device latency evidence only; no cross-device, throughput, power, energy, or multi-request claim.

implementation.mechanism: One CTA owns one token. It computes residual-left plus projection-right, rounds and stores the public BF16 residual, accumulates squares from that rounded value with the original 256-lane tree, applies centered RMSNorm, and writes BF16 normalized output.

schedule.next_layer_input_norm: folded into the preceding MLP residual boundary
schedule.final_norm: folded into the final-layer MLP residual boundary

fallbacks_unchanged: tail tiles such as the M31 tail in P64/C32

correctness_and_contract.finite_bitwise: 0 mismatches across 163840 residual values and 163840 normalized values for out-of-place, exact-right-alias, replay, and Graph replay cases

nan_operand_order.interpretation: The source and SASS preserve residual-left plus projection-right. On SM87 FADD canonicalizes these NaNs, so value-level operand-order observability is not claimed.

correctness_and_contract.selector: Only M32 and hidden-5120 selects the fused production schedule; M31, M33, H5119, and H5121 reject it.

checkpoint_fixtures.actual_fields: Only the norm weights are checkpoint payloads; activation and residual inputs are deterministic fixtures.

sass_and_resources.actual_grid_residency: The 32-CTA grid places two CTAs per each of 16 SMs; the resource ceiling is six CTAs per SM.

hot_same_binary_performance.protocol: 128 alternating warmups, six rounds, 512 recursive chains per pass, B-C-C-B order, actual layer-0 and layer-1 norm weights plus cancellation stress
hot_same_binary_performance.claim_boundary: This is a hot repeated-chain microbenchmark and is not the whole-Prefill speedup.

production_performance.workload: P513/C32/max1: 513 rendered prompt tokens, 512 prefix tokens, sixteen exact-M32 prefix tiles
production_performance.launch_and_span_note: CUDA Runtime attribution falls from 4096 launches/86.270048 ms to 2048 launches/44.537024 ms. Those API totals include profiler, enqueue, and GPU back-pressure and are not added to raw kernel time; observed prefix span idle falls by 8.526560 ms.

B_C_C_B_groups.baseline_identity: historical installed binary with the original post-GDN ELF Build ID

production_performance.profile_drift_boundary: The baseline and candidate Nsys captures were not paired. Common prefix kernels are 4.2976% slower in the candidate capture, dominated by a 9.6755% gate/up marginal-union shift, while identical finish-prefill work is 7.3398% faster. Cross-capture whole-phase time is therefore diagnostic only; unprofiled B-C-C-B is the promotion result.

validation.release_ctest: 56/56 completed without failure: 51 passed and 5 were configured skips; the four model-backed engine cases were run directly below
validation.independent_static_audit: GO; no correctness, API, scheduling, Graph, or warning blocker

promotion.reason: The exact-M32 route passes bitwise, special-value, alias, guard, replay, Graph, selector, resource, actual-model, hot micro, production topology, and two independent end-to-end B-C-C-B gates.
promotion.measured_scope: The whole-prefix improvement is about 0.28% on P513/C32, not 1.497x. The larger value applies only to a hot repeated two-kernel chain.
promotion.next_work: Use the promoted 256-thread kernel as C0, then screen packed-register residual caching and 512/768-thread shared-staging variants. Require at least 1.05x production-context improvement over C0 before changing the public launcher again.
